## Names

<a id="panel_charset"></a>
### [`panel_charset`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L6) `$E000-$E007`

*data*

Character set of the text rows 0-4 ($d018=$38, char base $e000), 128 characters in ASCII order. The panel shows hires characters (colour RAM 6, $142b).
Char $00: empty.

<a id="panel_yinyang_chars"></a>
### [`panel_yinyang_chars`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L9) `$E008-$E047`

*data*

Chars $01-$04: full yin-yang symbol (2x2, $18c2). Chars $05-$08: half yin-yang symbol ($18d7). $18ec clears them with spaces.

<a id="panel_empty_chars"></a>
### [`panel_empty_chars`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L19) `$E048-$E0FF`

*data*

Chars $09-$1f: 31 empty characters (all zero).

<a id="panel_font"></a>
### [`panel_font`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L44) `$E100-$E3F7`

*data*

Chars $20-$7f: font in ASCII order with digits, upper case and lower case letters and punctuation. v1 shows only space, 0-9 and A C D E H I L M N O P R S T V Y.

<a id="panel_char_solid"></a>
### [`panel_char_solid`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L140) `$E3F8-$E3FF`

*data*

Char $7f: solid block. No text of v1 uses it.

<a id="charset_ram_noise"></a>
### [`charset_ram_noise`](../../../../src/graphics/panel_charset.asm#L143) `$E400-$E5FF`

*data*

Chars $80-$bf: 512 bytes of RAM noise that M.CHSET saved with the 128 characters. Even bytes are mostly $00/$40/$80/$c0, odd bytes $3f/$7f/$bf/$ff, as at $c900, $79b0-$7adf and $ff80-$ffef. No text of the game uses them, but the rank text after the rank overflow does: at rank index 13 the panel shows char $8E from $e470.
